trap-triples.notes: STANDING-TRAP FINDING, structural, never fix math inline: 'e^- = sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 (trefoil)' is WRONG. Computed the closure's component count from the induced permutation: sigma_1 sigma_2 sigma_1 in B_3 induces the transposition (1 3), so its closure has TWO components and cannot be a knot, let alone the trefoil. Markov-reducing confirms it: sigma_1 sigma_2 sigma_1 is conjugate to sigma_1^2 sigma_2, which destabilises to sigma_1^2 in B_2, i.e. the HOPF LINK. The trefoil as a 3-braid is (sigma_1 sigma_2)^2, whose closure has one component (computed), or sigma_1^3 in B_2. The same error propagates to e^+ = sigma_0^{-1} sigma_1^{-1} sigma_0^{-1}, labelled 'mirror trefoil', which is the negative Hopf link. This matters beyond nomenclature: the electron is T_{2,3} (a knot) throughout the rest of this chapter - def:antineutrino-knot, prop:antiparticle-crossing-reversal and rem:beta-decay-skein-properties all use 'electron trefoil T_{2,3} = sigma_1^3' - so this definition contradicts its own chapter. Proposed fix: e^- = (sigma_0 sigma_1)^2, or sigma_0^3 in the 2-strand realisation. Secondary: the generator indexing starts at sigma_0, whereas H_3(q) elsewhere in the corpus uses sigma_1, sigma_2.
